description: This file implements a MemoryBufferWriter struct that provides a concrete implementation of the IBufferWriter<byte> interface for Memory<byte>. It manages buffer space, tracks bytes written, and allows advancing and providing memory spans or slices, with internal checks for capacity limits.

classes.name: MemoryBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> for Memory<byte>, providing methods to write to a buffer with internal capacity checks.

methods.name: MemoryBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer for writing.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current position by the specified count, throwing if exceeding buffer capacity.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> span from the current position with optional size hint, checking capacity.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> from the current position with optional size hint, checking capacity.
